The town that voted to keep its payphones

When the last telephone company in the valley announced it would remove the remaining payphones, the parish council of Lower Abbotsley did something no one expected: it voted to buy them.

Records we obtained show the council spent months negotiating over six handsets, most of which take only coins that went out of circulation years ago.
